candidates.angle: The verse lists the traits of a devotee dear to Krishna
candidates.evidence: करुण एव च (compassionate indeed) and क्षमी (forgiving)

candidates.angle: The verse pairs absence of ego with absence of possessiveness
candidates.evidence: निर्ममो निरहङ्कारः (without possessiveness and without ego)

candidates.angle: The verse describes a devotee with no hatred toward any being
candidates.evidence: अद्वेष्टा सर्वभूतानां (free from hatred of all beings)

en.intro: Krishna outlines the traits of a devotee who is dear to him. Listen for how he describes the absence of inner conflict.
en.notice: Krishna pairs two absences: without possessiveness and without ego. The devotee does not cling to possessions and does not claim the self, which leaves no room for inner conflict.
en.next: Krishna then adds that this devotee remains equal in pain and pleasure, steady through all conditions.
en.meaning: One who hates no being, is friendly and compassionate, free from possessiveness and ego, equal in pleasure and pain, and forgiving.

en.intro: Krishna outlines the traits of a devotee who is dear to him. Listen for how he describes the absence of inner conflict.
en.body: One who hates no being, is friendly and compassionate, free from possessiveness and ego, equal in pleasure and pain, and forgiving. Krishna pairs two absences: without possessiveness and without ego. The devotee does not cling to possessions and does not claim the self, which leaves no room for inner conflict. Krishna then adds that this devotee remains equal in pain and pleasure, steady through all conditions.

issues: unsupported: "निरन्तर सन्तुष्ट, योगी, शरीरको वशमें किये हुए, दृढ़ निश्चयवाला मेरेमें अर्पित मनबुद्धिवाला जो मेरा भक्त है, वह मेरेको प्रिय है" (These phrases (always content, yogi, body controlled, firm resolve, mind and intellect offered to Me) are not present in the provided Sanskrit source text of verse 13.)

borrowed: "कृष्ण कहते हैं कि ऐसा भक्त सुख-दुःख में समान रहता है और क्षमाशील होता है।" (This sentence is a summary of verse 13, but it borrows the phrasing 'समान रहता है' and 'क्षमाशील होता है' from verse 14's description, mixing the next verse's wording into the notice for this verse.)

borrowed: "ऐसे भक्त का मन और बुद्धि मुझमें अर्पित रहती है, जिससे वह मेरेको प्रिय होता है।" (This exact phrasing is taken from the NEXT verse (verse 14), not from the source of this verse (verse 13) which only lists the qualities of a devotee.)

contrast_template: "कृष्ण दो अभावों को साथ लाते हैं: निर्मम और निरहङ्कार। जो व्यक्ति न तो वस्तुओं को अपना मानता है और न ही स्वयं को, उसके भीतर कोई क्लेश या द्वन्द्व नहीं रहता।" (The phrase 'न तो... और न ही' (not X and not Y) creates a contrastive template 'not X but Y', implying that the devotee is not just free from possessiveness, but also not free from ego, or vice versa, which contradicts the source meaning that lists both as positive attributes (nir-mama and nir-ahankara) of the devotee.)
